title: pi-tools configuration
description: Global startup configuration for the pi-tools extension.

$schema.description: Schema URL used by editors for validation and completion.

mode.description: Controls which FFF tools and autocomplete integrations are enabled.

historyDbPath.description: Path to the query history database.

enableFsRootScanning.description: Allows indexing when pi is launched from the filesystem root.

enableHomeDirScanning.description: Allows indexing when pi is launched from the home directory.

enableTgrep.description: Registers the tgrep trigram-index search tool when the tgrep binary is found and the workspace has a .tgrep index.

tgrepBinPath.description: Explicit path to the tgrep binary; the TGREP_BIN environment variable takes precedence over config.tgrepBinPath, then PATH is used as a fallback.

tgrepTimeBudgetMs.description: Maximum milliseconds for a tgrep child process. TGREP_TIME_BUDGET_MS overrides this value.
